name: Krishival Foods Ltd
title: Krishival Foods Ltd - 544416 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: FY26 revenue INR304.41 cr (+48%), EBITDA margin 13.78%, PAT 7.59%; nuts plant utilisation ~70% in FY26 rising to ~90%, ice cream utilisation ~25% with capacity expansion phased to Q1 FY29.

utilisation.quote: our existing capacity, as I have spoken in the earlier call also, 70% was the utilization of the existing capacity

capex.quote: we have gone 20 this year, next year we'll go 30, and again next year we'll reach 40

triggers.label: Nuts capacity 10 → 20 t/day, path to 40
triggers.quote: our earlier capacity as of March 31, FY26 was 10 metric tons per day finished nuts production. This capacity has been enhanced as on today to 20 metric tons per day

triggers.label: FY27 ~50% revenue, 50%+ PAT growth
triggers.quote: we see around 50% top-line growth and 50% plus bottom-line growth

triggers.label: Ice cream utilisation ~25%
triggers.quote: the utilization in FY26 is 25% -- almost you can say 25%

guidance.quote: we see around 50% top-line growth and 50% plus bottom-line growth
we will try to maintain this 15% plus EBITDA and 10% plus PAT
PAT will also enhance beyond 3% minimum
around 25 such franchise -owned, company -operated Mellow & Co . ice cream outlets will be opened in the current financial year

red_flags.label: Preferential allottee shareholding exit; company disclaims knowledge
red_flags.quote: those people have invested and those are one of the shareholders

red_flags.label: Ice cream EBITDA margin dip in Q4 and ESOP cost
red_flags.quote: in Q4 FY26, there is a INR 2.88 crore, almost ESOP cost which has come into the books

red_flags.label: Rights issue proceeds only partly received
red_flags.quote: INR65 crores we'll receive in the subsequent two calls

evasions.quote: As long as that investor is not involved into the company's management or operation. So we don't have anything to do with that.

evasions.topic: Ice cream PAT breakeven / FoCo store financials
evasions.quote: So there is no question of breakeven as there are no overheads in our books.
